notes.title: Demo is available now!
notes.content:
The Smasher demo is live! Download it today and blast through the entire first level.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3774580/Smasher_Demo/
Fight through several arenas, swap a pile of guns, sling magic, then face a brutal first boss. 

We crammed in as much content as we could. Yet this is only a slice of Smasher’s final mayhem!

We also folded in your playtest feedback and, spoiler, rebuilt one of the core mechanics.

After you clear the demo, drop your impressions in the feedback form so we can push the game even further and melt more brains at launch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313339/c4a0e55d7a32e63cbe15bf15ac2d5e7545f2af80.gif

Below you’ll find the full patch notes, dev-backstage details, and everything packed into the demo.

Changes based on your feedback

Two weeks ago we ran a Steam playtest. Your comments were gold!

Since then the whole team has been grinding to fold as many improvements as possible into today’s demo.

Guns

Throwing and catching guns felt clunky for some of you, so we rebuilt the entire system: 

 Pin-point throws – guns now fly exactly where you expect
 Magnetic beam pickup – a clear visual cue when you yank a weapon back
 “Chewy” effect – guns gently snap to your hand so they’re harder to fumble

Hub

Major and minor improvements:

 Shooting range to test any weapon
 Extra hints for both magic and guns
 Streamlined spell-selection navigation

Tutorial

 Trimmed the fat and shortened the essential bits for a faster start
 Reworked confusing segments

Text & Localization

More optional lore, fixes to older lines, and full localisation into ten languages:

 English
 German
 French
 Spanish
 Portuguese
 Russian
 Polish
 Simplified Chinese
 Korean
 Japanese

Visuals & Tech

Squashed every gameplay and visual bug we found – no critical issues left. If you spot one we missed, please let us know through the feedback form.

TL;DR

The playtest was invaluable. Thank you!

If you filled out the form before, tell us if today’s demo feels better.

You also asked for more content – and it’s coming. Watch for it in the full release later this year. 😊

What’s in the demo

The demo delivers the entire first level in its final state: a skyscraper ascent made of several unique locations, capped by a boss battle.

Locations

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313339/82cbb389018c484f69533545cb575423ab069540.gif

 Lobby with an alarm button – Stop enemies from slapping it, or brace for backup reinforcements
 Elevator ride – Because no action movie skips the elevator
 Server room with a hacking terminal – Keep your hands on the terminal while bullets fly
 Skybridge – Rockets, explosions, death lasers, and the Mother Drone boss waiting at the end. Good luck!

Boss

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313339/5466f5ba635500644cd53e153c2c4287e586327a.gif

Multi-phase fight, eye-laser death ray, rocket barrages, swarms of minions, and a tiny you. Stay mobile, spam every ability, and watch the arena for goodies.

Guns

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313339/8466fbfb2f45bda5f63a4fae327eebeb83111ab2.gif

Arm yourself (and your enemies’ faces) with:

 “Volt-9” Pistol
 “BlitzHex” SMG
 “Scatterline” Shotgun
 “RLT-1” Rocket Launcher

Magic

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313339/4810bd0a91c8f8a740e41faa0d36933b792526c9.gif

Because explosions alone aren’t enough:

 Fireball
 Frost Beam
 Void Shield
 Telekinesis Pull

Menu

No boring static menu here. An interactive hub lets you launch the level and tweak settings with an actual computer, test weapons in the shooting range, and pick a spell crystal for your glove with your own hands.

Soundtrack

Original score, crafted in-house. And yes, we’ve had it on repeat for weeks. A chunk of it is in the demo. Hope you love the tracks as much as we do.

Thank you for the support ❤️

The demo lands just in time for Next Fest. Feel free to leave a review on the Smasher demo page – it helps a ton.

Most of all, have fun and raise havoc!

See you soon in the next devlog, where we’ll unveil more launch content: a brutal new enemy, a scorching weapon, and a massive location.

With love,
The Smasher VR Team 💙

notes.title: Devlog #0 – “Cold Steel, Surprise Hacks, and a Stubborn Cargo Crane”
notes.content:
Hey there, folks!

The Smasher team is back with a bunch of cool stuff we’ve been cooking up. Today, we’re showing off:
And a bonus at the end – a brutal melee weapon that doesn’t shoot, but sure as hell makes up for it

 A brand-new location where magic meets technology – the crystal depot
 An enemy who doesn’t break walls, but your patience – the hacker
 And a bonus at the end – a brutal melee weapon that doesn’t shoot, but sure as hell makes up for it

Location spotlight: The Crystal Depot

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313339/224dcd46c35587f767e19ce40f945af30f72532c.jpg
The Crystal Depot is a fusion of tech and sorcery. At its heart lies a generator powering an old crane that’s sorting crates full of rare crystals. And those crystal crates? They don’t always play nice – sometimes they help, sometimes they throw a wrench into your plans.

Enemies come at you from all directions, trying to reach the generator and shut it all down. All you can do is hold the line and make sure the depot doesn’t descend into chaos.

Enemy: The Hacker

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313339/1a6d9a720205132186cd43c86a3fdba2b4bf7e5b.gif

He doesn’t roar, doesn’t wave a weapon, and definitely doesn’t aggro on you with fists. He just calmly walks up to a key point and starts typing. Miss your chance to react — and boom, your weapon’s fried. Now you’re stuck in a firefight with no trusty firepower.

He looks harmless, but hits like an IT guy with admin access to your account.

The hacker doesn’t test your strength — he tests your focus. Or your willingness to pay the price.

Weapon: Katana

Speed. Precision. Satisfaction.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313339/eb60c609fce07a2869f94eb5d33f87b7658d5054.png
The katana can slice through multiple enemies in close range, and even sends out a wave to finish off that guy who thought he was safe in the back.

You don’t just press a button – you swing it with your own hands. Like in those movies where everything comes down to a single, perfect samurai strike.

And if you mess it up… Well, you’ve only got yourself — and maybe the corner of the room — to blame.

Your Support Means the World to Us

We’re still actively gathering feedback and fine-tuning every little detail. Got questions, ideas, or memes? Send ‘em to us!

The next devlog is already bubbling on the stove — and a fresh public build isn’t far behind either!

See you in the next update!

With love,
The Smasher Team 💙
